removed_routes.deleted_by: ea3eaf377 — feat(retirement): retire GoHighLevel and the legacy cleaning product (PR #294)
removed_routes.arithmetic: 21 exceptions - 4 = 17; 26 unresolved - 9 = 17. Both match the check's live output.
removed_routes.verified_absent: web/app/api/book-v2 does not exist on disk and no app/api/book-v2 path is tracked; lib/book-v2/** helpers survive and are reached only by routes that resolve a principal.

intermediate_commit.assessment: A consequence of the deletion, not a workaround. The shrink-only rule made the now-stale entries fail Vercel's prebuild, which is the register working as designed. It emptied the lists rather than relaxing the check.

delta_reconciliation.exposure_status: The five frozen-baseline routes were the largest live exposure Wave 1 documented. They are closed BY DELETION, not by remediation. W-15 inherits no work from the frozen baseline.

defect_found_and_fixed.severity: moderate — a silent weakening of the only bound on exception growth
defect_found_and_fixed.observed: The lock asserted subject_unresolved <= 26 (the 2026-07-31 figure) while the live floor had fallen to 17.
defect_found_and_fixed.why_it_matters: The `exceptions` list is deliberately not frozen — only `baseline` is — so this numeric ceiling was the only thing bounding exception growth. With 9 routes of slack, nine new service-role routes resolving no principal could have been added to `exceptions` and the build would have stayed green. A retirement had silently bought the codebase nine free exceptions.
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: Ceiling tightened 26 -> 17, equal to the current floor, so any addition goes red. Comment records the retirement that caused the drop.
defect_found_and_fixed.principle: A ratchet is only a ratchet if it follows the floor down. Re-tighten whenever the floor drops.
defect_found_and_fixed.verified: 15/15 lock tests green after the change; 17 <= 17 sits exactly at the floor.

register_review.selection_rationale: The subject-binding pair is the register's strongest claim — the only exceptions that accept a caller-supplied row id at all. The prior run spot-checked verticals and webhooks/resend; a different pair was chosen so coverage accumulates across runs.

limits_unchanged.stated_limit: The check proves a principal is RESOLVED, never that the result GATES the handler. A resolution whose result is discarded passes. Nothing in this re-run narrows this; W-14's declared table and W-15's sweep still own that proof.
limits_unchanged.enforced_subject: Direct holding only. Transitive reachers are advisory because the transitive graph over-credits (556 of 559 reach one).
limits_unchanged.non_ast_predicate: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY as a text marker, which can only widen the subject set, never narrow it.
